note: Initial manufacturer-aware ADAS control catalog. Small by design: each entry is independently verifiable from the cited source. Certainty describes confidence in the REFERENCE's applicability (confirmed = official document directly verified; provisional = manual mirror or excerpt; definitional = true by control semantics). No manual illustrations are reproduced.

entries.control_description: Vehicle Distance button on the steering wheel; sets the vehicle-to-vehicle follow distance
entries.distinctions: Conventional cruise SET/RES/+/- buttons without a distance function are not ACC evidence. Distance adjustment is the ACC-specific function.

sources.doc: Kia Forte 2021 Features & Functions Guide, Smart Cruise Control (SCC), page 20
sources.section: Smart Cruise Control (SCC): To set the vehicle distance

sources.doc: Kia Feature Tips BD_M_SCC (2022), Smart Cruise Control quick tips

entries.certainty_note: Guide text verified via search excerpts quoting the document; direct page/PDF fetch was blocked in this environment. Official Kia documents; mirror URLs recorded.

entries.control_description: Dedicated LKA button on the instrument panel on the lower left-hand side of the driver; cluster lane indicator white (standby) / green (steering)
entries.symbol: lane-assistance button; cluster lane indicator with white/green state semantics
entries.distinctions: NOT Lane Following Assist (LFA): LFA is Kia's separate lane-centering system with steering-wheel buttons. LKA button existence does not establish LFA, ACC, or hands-free capability.

sources.doc: Kia Forte 2019-2024 (BD) Owner's Manual, Driving your vehicle / Lane Keeping Assist (LKA) system / LKA operation
sources.section: LKA operation: LKA button location; indicator states

entries.certainty_note: Manual text verified in full via a manual mirror; official Kia PDF not directly fetched. Location (instrument panel lower-left) and dedicated function are explicit in the text.

entries.control_description: Driver-assistance button on the end face of the turn-signal lever (E617); opens/configures assistance systems alongside the infotainment Assistance systems menu
entries.symbol: assistance-system button on stalk end face
entries.distinctions: A menu opener: accessing assistance settings does not prove any particular system (lane keeping, centering, ACC) is installed or enabled. Do not infer per-system capability from this control alone.

sources.doc: Volkswagen Service Training: lane departure warning operation (E617 driver assistance systems button on turn signal lever face)
sources.section: Lane departure warning: switching on/off via E617

sources.doc: Volkswagen Jetta 2021 Quick Start Guide (official vw.com PDF): Assist Syst. vehicle settings menu

entries.certainty_note: Verified via document excerpts; arrangement varies by model year and equipment, so this entry is intentionally non-diagnostic.

entries.control_description: Generic ON/SET/RES/+/- cruise buttons with no follow-distance function
entries.distinctions: Evidence of conventional cruise only. Without a distance/follow function these controls say nothing about adaptive capability.

sources.doc: Definitional: a control exposing only set/resume/on-off with no distance function cannot be ACC-specific

entries.certainty_note: True by control semantics, not by manual lookup.

entries.control_description: Lane Following Assist controls on the steering wheel (right side on K5); maintains the vehicle between lane markings
entries.distinctions: Kia LFA is the centering-tier system, distinct from LKA (dash button). Supportive rather than diagnostic here because wheel-button identification alone is weaker than the LKA dash-button case.

sources.doc: Kia K5 2024 Quick Start: LFA buttons on right side of steering wheel
Kia Seltos Feature Tips: LFA maintains the vehicle between the lanes

entries.certainty_note: Verified via document excerpts; wheel-button layout varies by model.

entries.control_description: Volkswagen's 'Lane Assist' naming denotes corrective-steering lane keeping (active above ~35 mph), not lane centering or Travel Assist
entries.distinctions: VW Lane Assist is keeping-tier. Travel Assist (centering + ACC combination) and hands-free require their own evidence.

sources.doc: Volkswagen Jetta GLI 2021 Owner's Manual: Lane Assist corrective steering above 35 mph

entries.certainty_note: Naming/interpretation entry (no physical control). Verified via manual excerpts.
